title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to negotiate the terms and enter into a Master Cooperative Agreement (MCA) with the Southern California Regional Rail…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0526, Agreement]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to negotiate the terms and enter into a Master Cooperative Agreement (MCA) with the Southern California Regional Rail Authority (SCRRA) for railroad support activities associated with Metro-sponsored rail improvement projects within Los Angeles County (Attachment A).
summary: Metro would negotiate and sign a master cooperative agreement with the Southern California Regional Rail Authority covering railroad support work for Metro-sponsored rail projects across Los Angeles County.
